items.title: Nepal’s leaders call for unity as Shah highlights Dashain’s financial strain
items.blurb: Prime Minister Balendra Shah said financial hardship should not make the festival a burden, while the president and vice-president stressed social harmony and support for families affected by disasters.

items.title: Bhotekoshi flood displaced 777 students. Nepal plans five-year school recovery
items.blurb: Of the 57 educational institutions assessed in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, and Dhading districts, 28 were damaged and 15 were completely destroyed.

items.title: Beijing’s security concerns cloud Nepal’s push to reopen Tatopani
items.blurb: Flood damage to Rasuwagadhi and the high cost of Korala leave the Sindhupalchok crossing vital to Nepal’s trade with China, but Beijing remains reluctant to reopen it over concerns about Tibet.

items.title: Over 1,500 flood-hit children suffer acute malnutrition
items.blurb: Thirteen children have severe acute malnutrition, while experts warn that delayed intervention could push more children into life-threatening conditions.

items.title: 30MW Khani Khola hydropower project begins test generation
items.blurb: The project in Dolakha district is supplying electricity to the national grid during a 15-day testing period before commercial operations begin.

items.title: Government declares flood- and landslide-hit areas in three districts disaster zones
items.blurb: The three-month designation covers six local units or parts of them in Gorkha, Dhading and Baglung, with affected families eligible for monthly housing and livelihood assistance of at least Rs15,000.

items.title: Dashain shopping picks up, but livestock sales lag in Chitwan
items.blurb: Traders who brought goats and Himalayan goats from western Nepal had hoped for brisk business, but buyers have been slower to arrive than expected.

items.title: Build infrastructure that stands the test of time
items.blurb: From now on, disaster resilience must guide every stage of Nepal’s reconstruction.

items.title: How will Nepal verify those missing after the Bhotekoshi floods?
items.blurb: The government has begun compiling an official list of people missing in the August 26 disaster. The process will determine who can be declared dead and whose families qualify for relief.
